title: Forward weighted two point contraction
statement: Let $q,\lambda,u,v\in\bbr$ satisfy $q>2$ and $0<\lambda<1/2$. Set $\rho=\rho(q,\lambda)$, the sharp discrete hypercontractive radius, and $m=\lambda u+(1-\lambda)v$. Then $\big(\lambda|\rho u+(1-\rho)m|^q+(1-\lambda)|\rho v+(1-\rho)m|^q\big)^{2/q}\le\lambda u^2+(1-\lambda)v^2$.
replaced: Let $q>2$, $0<\lambda<1/2$, and $u,v\in\bbr$. Put $\rho=\rho_*(q,\lambda)$ and $m=\lambda u+(1-\lambda)v$. Then $(\lambda|\rho u+(1-\rho)m|^q+(1-\lambda)|\rho v+(1-\rho)m|^q)^{2/q}\le\lambda u^2+(1-\lambda)v^2$. Here $\rho_*(q,\lambda)=\sqrt{\sinh(\ell/q)/\sinh(\ell/(q/(q-1)))}$ with $\ell=\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)$.
